name: Valproic Acid (Valproate Semisodium)
dosing: As sodium valproate (doses expressed as valproic acid)
contraindications: Pregnancy (highly teratogenic); known mitochondrial disorders (e.g., POLG-related); hypersensitivity to valproate
interactions: Numerous pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic interactions (enzyme inhibition/induction) — check interactions for co-prescribed antiepileptics and psychotropics
monitoring: Baseline and regular LFTs and full blood count, serum valproate levels where indicated, and monitoring of clinical response; ensure Pregnancy Prevention Programme for women of childbearing potential
pregnancy: Contraindicated in pregnancy due to high teratogenic risk; specialist advice required and discuss alternatives for women of childbearing potential
sideEffects: Common: weight gain, tremor; serious: hepatotoxicity (especially in young children), pancreatitis, teratogenicity; risk of hyperammonemia
pharmacokinetics: Highly protein-bound; hepatic metabolism with several pathways; interactions common
clinicalPearls: Use specialist guidance for initiation and monitoring; ensure effective contraception in women of childbearing potential and enrolment in risk-management programmes
indication: Epilepsy, bipolar affective disorder, and certain cases of migraine prophylaxis (selected patients)
